about: Registry of the ⚠РФ mark (docs/k3/SPEC-stage1-rf-mark-builtin.md §2): organisations recognised as extremist in the Russian Federation and their domains. domains — suffixes (meta.com marks about.meta.com too); exclude is stronger than domains; iplist — stage 2. Not marked: Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok, media — blocked, undesirable and foreign-agent are other categories. Every domain of Meta checked 2026-10-15: name servers of Meta (ns.facebook.com, ns.instagram.com) or the registrant Meta Platforms, Inc. in WHOIS. sources[].checked — only for a page that was really opened.

title.ru: Перечень террористов и экстремистов (Росфинмониторинг): Meta Platforms Inc. — п. 17, некоммерческая организация «Фонд борьбы с коррупцией» — п. 675
title.en: List of terrorists and extremists (Rosfinmonitoring): Meta Platforms Inc. — item 17, the non-profit organisation Anti-Corruption Foundation — item 675

title.ru: Единый федеральный список организаций, в том числе иностранных и международных организаций, признанных судами Российской Федерации террористическими (ФСБ России)
title.en: Unified federal list of organisations, including foreign and international ones, recognised as terrorist by courts of the Russian Federation (FSB of Russia)

basis.ru: решение Тверского районного суда г. Москвы от 21.03.2022; WhatsApp решением не затронут
basis.en: decision of the Tverskoy District Court of Moscow of 21 March 2022; WhatsApp is not covered by it

orgs.scope: services of Meta and their CDN: Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Messenger, Meta AI, Llama, Oculus/Quest, Workplace; open projects handed over to foundations (PyTorch) are not marked; WhatsApp is not marked

basis.en: decision of the Moscow City Court of 9 June 2021

basis.ru: Anti-Corruption Foundation, Inc. (ACF, «Фонд борьбы с коррупцией, Инк.»): решение Верховного суда РФ от 27.11.2025 № АКПИ25-862с, в силу с 12.02.2026; перечень ФСБ, п. 72
basis.en: Anti-Corruption Foundation, Inc. (ACF): decision of the Supreme Court of Russia of 27 November 2025 No. AKPI25-862s, in force since 12 February 2026; FSB list, item 72

orgs.domains_basis: navalny.com — blocked by Roskomnadzor in July 2021 as a resource of the extremist organisation (FBK); fbk.info is not listed: no confirmation from an official source
